summary: One focused behavior: extend the section 35 particle toolbox (src/render/particles.ts ParticleField/makeLayer) with the two section 48 juice particle layers, bubbles and silt, driven by a new data-driven per-band emission table (new data module next to the band profiles or a BandProfile extension in src/render/band.ts). Verified against source: ParticleField already owns pooled buffers, per-band count tracking and the active-chunks ambient gate, so the extend-not-rebuild framing and both changed responsibilities (2, within the limit) are accurate; tests are excluded from the responsibility count. AC-art-geometry is retained verbatim from the parent and correctly deferred to WI-06d-b6 as final proof owner of the six-effect browser union rather than re-asserted here; AC-juice-particles is a child-local focused criterion. depends_on [WI-06a, WI-06b, WI-06c] exists in ST-06/workitems, is inherited from the story, and avoids ancestors and descendants. Verification is focused: Node unit tests for emission-table values and the two new layers, a per-band browser clip for bubbles/silt only, headless/build green, section 34 budgets. Handoff names the story plan, the three band items, the two source files with their extension points, and request sections 14.1, 14.3, 34, 35, 48, 70, sufficient for a fresh implementer.
